original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')       and i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    customer_demographics.cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    count(*) as cnt
FROM
    store_sales,
    web_sales,
    date_dim d1,
    date_dim d2,
    customer,
    inventory,
    store,
    warehouse,
    customer_demographics,
    household_demographics,
    customer_address
WHERE
    ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    AND ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)
    AND ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    AND ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    AND ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk
    AND ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
    AND inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity
    AND s_state = w_state
    AND c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
    AND c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
    AND c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    AND ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
    AND d1.d_year = 2001
    AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item WHERE i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports') AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95))
GROUP BY customer_demographics.cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')       and i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH
item_sub AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk FROM item WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music') AND i_manager_id IN (6,10,21,31,34,57,70,73,85,96)
),
d1_sub AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001
),
d2_sub AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim
),
ss_sub AS (
  SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_quantity FROM store_sales
),
ws_sub AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_warehouse_sk, ws_sold_date_sk FROM web_sales WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51
),
inv_sub AS (
  SELECT inv_warehouse_sk, inv_item_sk, inv_date_sk, inv_quantity_on_hand FROM inventory
),
w_sub AS (
  SELECT w_warehouse_sk, w_state FROM warehouse
),
s_sub AS (
  SELECT s_state FROM store
),
customer_sub AS (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk
  FROM customer c
  JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  WHERE ca.ca_state IN ('FL','MO','PA','SC','TX')
),
cd_sub AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status FROM customer_demographics
),
hd_sub AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_vehicle_count FROM household_demographics
)
SELECT cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM ss_sub ss
JOIN item_sub i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN d1_sub d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN inv_sub inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
  AND inv.inv_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN ws_sub ws ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
  AND ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN d2_sub d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)
JOIN customer_sub c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
JOIN w_sub w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
  AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN s_sub s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
JOIN cd_sub cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN hd_sub hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status, hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

rewritten_query:
WITH item_filtered AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Men')
    AND i_manager_id IN (9, 24, 27, 41, 59, 66, 78, 80, 83, 100)
),
date_dim_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
store_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_quantity
  FROM store_sales

),
web_sales_filtered AS (

),
customer_filtered AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_hdemo_sk, c_current_addr_sk
  FROM customer
),
customer_address_filtered AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('AL', 'MI', 'MS', 'OH', 'TX')
),
store_warehouse_join AS (
  SELECT s_store_sk, w_warehouse_sk
  FROM store
  JOIN warehouse ON s_state = w_state
),
joined_data AS (
  SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count
  FROM store_sales_filtered ss
  JOIN web_sales_filtered ws
    ON ws.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim_filtered d1
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_dim d2
    ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND d2.d_date >= d1.d_date
    AND d2.d_date <= d1.d_date + interval '30' day
  JOIN customer_filtered c
    ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd
    ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd
    ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_address_filtered ca
    ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN inventory inv
    ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv.inv_warehouse_sk = ws.ws_warehouse_sk
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
  JOIN store_warehouse_join sw
    ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = sw.w_warehouse_sk
)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM joined_data
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt;

original_query: with customer_total_return as (select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk ,sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk ,sum(SR_REFUNDED_CASH) as ctr_total_return from store_returns ,date_dim where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year =2001 and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 236 and 295 group by sr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk)  select  c_customer_id from customer_total_return ctr1 ,store ,customer ,customer_demographics where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return)*1.2 from customer_total_return ctr2 where ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk ) and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31 and s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk and s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI') and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'W') and cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College') and cd_gender = 'M' and c_birth_month = 5 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956 order by c_customer_id limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
           sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
           SUM(sr_refunded_cash) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns, date_dim
    WHERE sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
      AND d_year = 2001
      AND sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 236 AND 295
    GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk
),
store_avg AS (
    SELECT ctr_store_sk,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS threshold
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN store_avg sa ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = sa.ctr_store_sk AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.threshold
JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
JOIN customer c ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31
  AND s.s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI')
  AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
  AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College')
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'M'
  AND c.c_birth_month = 5
  AND c.c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956
ORDER BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100;

WITH customer_total_return AS (

         sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,

original_query: with customer_total_return as (select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk ,sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk ,sum(SR_STORE_CREDIT) as ctr_total_return from store_returns ,date_dim where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year =2000 and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 107 and 166 group by sr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk)  select  c_customer_id from customer_total_return ctr1 ,store ,customer ,customer_demographics where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return)*1.2 from customer_total_return ctr2 where ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk ) and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 17 AND 20 and s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk and s_state IN ('MO', 'NC', 'PA') and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'W') and cd_education_status IN ('College', 'Unknown') and cd_gender = 'F' and c_birth_month = 5 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1956 AND 1962 order by c_customer_id limit 100;

with customer_total_return as (
    select
        sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk,
        sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk,

    where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk

        and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 107 and 166

join store on s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk

filtered_date_dim_d1 AS (

WITH store_exists AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON (ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk)
    JOIN item ON (ss_item_sk = i_item_sk)
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 4
      AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100
      AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.17 AND 0.27
),
web_or_catalog_exists AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON (ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk)
    JOIN item ON (ws_item_sk = i_item_sk)
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 4
      AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100
      AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.17 AND 0.27
    UNION
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON (cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk)
    JOIN item ON (cs_item_sk = i_item_sk)
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 4
      AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 91 AND 100
      AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.17 AND 0.27
)
SELECT cd_gender,
       cd_marital_status,
       cd_education_status,
       count(*) AS cnt1,
       cd_purchase_estimate,
       count(*) AS cnt2,
       cd_credit_rating,
       count(*) AS cnt3,
       cd_dep_count,
       count(*) AS cnt4,
       cd_dep_employed_count,
       count(*) AS cnt5,
       cd_dep_college_count,
       count(*) AS cnt6
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    AND ca.ca_county IN ('Audubon County','Dade County','Dewey County','Hardeman County','Talbot County')
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
    AND cd_marital_status IN ('M','U')
    AND cd_education_status IN ('Primary','College','4 yr Degree')
    AND cd_gender = 'M'
WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (4,5)
  AND c.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT ss_customer_sk FROM store_exists)
  AND c.c_customer_sk IN (SELECT customer_sk FROM web_or_catalog_exists)
GROUP BY cd_gender,

         cd_education_status,
         cd_purchase_estimate,
         cd_credit_rating,
         cd_dep_count,
         cd_dep_employed_count,
         cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY cd_gender,
         cd_marital_status,
         cd_education_status,
         cd_purchase_estimate,
         cd_credit_rating,
         cd_dep_count,
         cd_dep_employed_count,
         cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_store_sales AS (
  SELECT ss_quantity, ss_ext_sales_price, ss_ext_wholesale_cost, ss_store_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_addr_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_sales_price, ss_net_profit
  FROM store_sales

    (ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
    OR (ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)

     OR (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
),
filtered_household_demographics AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_dep_count
  FROM household_demographics
  WHERE hd_dep_count IN (1, 3)
),
filtered_customer_address AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state

  WHERE d_year = 2001

WITH date_filter AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
hd_filter_3 AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk
  FROM household_demographics
  WHERE hd_dep_count = 3
),
hd_filter_1 AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk
  FROM household_demographics
  WHERE hd_dep_count = 1
),
cd_filter_S_Secondary AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
),
cd_filter_S_2yr AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree'
),
ca_filter_MS_NY_VA AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('MS', 'NY', 'VA')
),
ca_filter_MS_TN_TX AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('MS', 'TN', 'TX')
),
ca_filter_NC_NM_OK AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_country = 'United States' AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'NM', 'OK')
),
store_filter AS (
  SELECT s_store_sk
  FROM store
)
SELECT MIN(ss_quantity), MIN(ss_ext_sales_price), MIN(ss_ext_wholesale_cost), MIN(ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM store_sales
JOIN date_filter ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
JOIN store_filter ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store_filter.s_store_sk
WHERE (
  (store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk IN (SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM hd_filter_3)
   AND store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk IN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM cd_filter_S_Secondary)
   AND store_sales.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
  OR
  (store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk IN (SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM hd_filter_1)
   AND store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk IN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM cd_filter_S_Secondary)
   AND store_sales.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
  OR
  (store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk IN (SELECT hd_demo_sk FROM hd_filter_1)
   AND store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk IN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM cd_filter_S_2yr)
   AND store_sales.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
)
AND (
  (store_sales.ss_addr_sk IN (SELECT ca_address_sk FROM ca_filter_MS_NY_VA)
   AND store_sales.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
  OR
  (store_sales.ss_addr_sk IN (SELECT ca_address_sk FROM ca_filter_MS_TN_TX)
   AND store_sales.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
  OR
  (store_sales.ss_addr_sk IN (SELECT ca_address_sk FROM ca_filter_NC_NM_OK)
   AND store_sales.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
);

WITH cross_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk AS ss_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND (i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id) IN (
      SELECT iss.i_brand_id, iss.i_class_id, iss.i_category_id
      FROM store_sales
      JOIN item iss ON ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
      JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
      WHERE d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND iss.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
        AND iss.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
        AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
      INTERSECT
      SELECT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id
      FROM catalog_sales
      JOIN item ics ON cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
      JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
      WHERE d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND ics.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
        AND ics.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
        AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
      INTERSECT
      SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
      FROM web_sales
      JOIN item iws ON ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
      JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
      WHERE d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
        AND iws.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
        AND iws.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
        AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    )
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity, cs_list_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity, ws_list_price
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  ) x
)
SELECT this_year.channel AS ty_channel,
       this_year.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
       this_year.i_class_id AS ty_class,
       this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,
       this_year.sales AS ty_sales,
       this_year.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
       last_year.channel AS ly_channel,
       last_year.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
       last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
       last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
       last_year.sales AS ly_sales,
       last_year.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
         i_brand_id,
         i_class_id,
         i_category_id,
         SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
         COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items)
    AND d_week_seq = (
      SELECT d_week_seq
      FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_year = 1999
        AND d_moy = 12
        AND d_dom = 13
    )
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
) this_year
JOIN (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
         i_brand_id,
         i_class_id,
         i_category_id,
         SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
         COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE ss_item_sk IN (SELECT ss_item_sk FROM cross_items)
    AND d_week_seq = (
      SELECT d_week_seq
      FROM date_dim
      WHERE d_year = 1998
        AND d_moy = 12
        AND d_dom = 13
    )
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
) last_year
ON this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id
   AND this_year.i_class_id = last_year.i_class_id

customer_filtered AS (

),
cs_filtered AS (
  SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_bill_cdemo_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, cs_quantity, cs_list_price, cs_coupon_amt, cs_sales_price, cs_net_profit
  FROM catalog_sales
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 84 AND 89
)
SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county,
  avg(cast(cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) agg1,
  avg(cast(cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) agg2,
  avg(cast(cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) agg3,

JOIN customer_filtered ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk

WITH filtered_d2 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 5
),
filtered_store_returns AS (
  SELECT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_customer_sk, sr_returned_date_sk
  FROM store_returns
  WHERE sr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_d2)
),
joined_sales_returns AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_store_sk, ss.ss_sold_date_sk, ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_customer_sk,
         sr.sr_returned_date_sk
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN filtered_store_returns sr
    ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
   AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
),
filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT jsr.ss_store_sk, jsr.ss_sold_date_sk, jsr.sr_returned_date_sk
  FROM joined_sales_returns jsr
  JOIN filtered_d2 d2 ON jsr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_dim d1 ON jsr.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  WHERE d1.d_date BETWEEN d2.d_date - INTERVAL '120' DAY AND d2.d_date
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT ss_store_sk,
         SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
         SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk) > 30 AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk) <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
         SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk) > 60 AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
         SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk) > 90 AND (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk) <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
         SUM(CASE WHEN (sr_returned_date_sk - ss_sold_date_sk) > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY ss_store_sk
)
SELECT s.s_store_name, s.s_company_id, s.s_street_number, s.s_street_name, s.s_street_type,
       s.s_suite_number, s.s_city, s.s_county, s.s_state, s.s_zip,
       agg."30 days", agg."31-60 days", agg."61-90 days", agg."91-120 days", agg.">120 days"
FROM aggregated agg
JOIN store s ON agg.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
ORDER BY s.s_store_name, s.s_company_id, s.s_street_number, s.s_street_name, s.s_street_type,
         s.s_suite_number, s.s_city, s.s_county, s.s_state, s.s_zip
LIMIT 100;

),
my_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk
  FROM customer
  JOIN (
    SELECT cs_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category = 'Electronics' AND i_class = 'portable'
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_moy = 6 AND d_year = 2002
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN item ON ws_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category = 'Electronics' AND i_class = 'portable'
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_moy = 6 AND d_year = 2002

  ) AS sales ON c_customer_sk = sales.customer_sk
  WHERE c_birth_year BETWEEN 1978 AND 1991
),
my_revenue AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM my_customers
  JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk

  CROSS JOIN date_range
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 70 AND 100

with cs_ui as (
  select cs_item_sk,
         sum(cs_ext_list_price) as sale,
         sum(cr_refunded_cash+cr_reversed_charge+cr_store_credit) as refund
  from catalog_sales
  join catalog_returns
    on cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
   and cs_order_number = cr_order_number
  where cs_wholesale_cost between 80 and 100
  group by cs_item_sk
  having sum(cs_ext_list_price) > 2*sum(cr_refunded_cash+cr_reversed_charge+cr_store_credit)
),
cross_sales as (
  select i_product_name product_name,
         i_item_sk item_sk,
         s_store_name store_name,
         s_zip store_zip,
         ad1.ca_street_number b_street_number,
         ad1.ca_street_name b_street_name,
         ad1.ca_city b_city,
         ad1.ca_zip b_zip,
         ad2.ca_street_number c_street_number,
         ad2.ca_street_name c_street_name,
         ad2.ca_city c_city,
         ad2.ca_zip c_zip,
         d1.d_year as syear,
         d2.d_year as fsyear,
         d3.d_year s2year,
         count(*) cnt,
         sum(ss_wholesale_cost) s1,
         sum(ss_list_price) s2,
         sum(ss_coupon_amt) s3
  from store_sales
  join store_returns
    on ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
   and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
  join cs_ui
    on ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
  join date_dim d1
    on ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  join store
    on ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
  join customer
    on ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  join customer_demographics cd1
    on ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
  join household_demographics hd1
    on ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  join customer_address ad1
    on ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
  join item
    on ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  join customer_demographics cd2
    on c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
  join household_demographics hd2
    on c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  join customer_address ad2
    on c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
  join date_dim d2
    on c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  join date_dim d3
    on c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  join promotion
    on ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  join income_band ib1
    on hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
  join income_band ib2
    on hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  where ss_wholesale_cost between 80 and 100
    and i_current_price between 1 and 11
    and p_channel_email = 'Y'
    and p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    and p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    and ad2.ca_state in ('GA','IL','OH')
    and cd1.cd_marital_status in ('W','D')
    and cd1.cd_education_status in ('College','4 yr Degree')
    and cd2.cd_marital_status in ('W','D')
    and cd2.cd_education_status in ('College','4 yr Degree')
    and cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
  group by i_product_name,
           i_item_sk,
           s_store_name,
           s_zip,
           ad1.ca_street_number,
           ad1.ca_street_name,
           ad1.ca_city,
           ad1.ca_zip,
           ad2.ca_street_number,
           ad2.ca_street_name,
           ad2.ca_city,
           ad2.ca_zip,
           d1.d_year,
           d2.d_year,
           d3.d_year
)
select cs1.product_name,
       cs1.store_name,
       cs1.store_zip,
       cs1.b_street_number,
       cs1.b_street_name,
       cs1.b_city,
       cs1.b_zip,
       cs1.c_street_number,
       cs1.c_street_name,
       cs1.c_city,
       cs1.c_zip,
       cs1.syear,
       cs1.cnt,
       cs1.s1 as s11,
       cs1.s2 as s21,
       cs1.s3 as s31,
       cs2.s1 as s12,
       cs2.s2 as s22,
       cs2.s3 as s32,
       cs2.syear,
       cs2.cnt
from cross_sales cs1
join cross_sales cs2
  on cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk
 and cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name
 and cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip
 and cs1.syear = 1999
 and cs2.syear = 2000
 and cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt
order by cs1.product_name,
         cs1.store_name,
         cs2.cnt,
         cs1.s1,
         cs2.s1;

WITH catalog_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt,
         cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_return_amount,0.0) AS sales_amt
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN item ON i_item_sk=cs_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk=cs_sold_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number=cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk=cr_item_sk)
  WHERE i_category='Women'
    AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.68 AND 0.88
    AND cr_reason_sk IN (9, 19, 23, 33, 44)
),
store_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt,
         ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr_return_amt,0.0) AS sales_amt
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN item ON i_item_sk=ss_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk=ss_sold_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns ON (ss_ticket_number=sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk=sr_item_sk)
  WHERE i_category='Women'
    AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.68 AND 0.88
    AND sr_reason_sk IN (9, 19, 23, 33, 44)
),
web_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt,
         ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr_return_amt,0.0) AS sales_amt
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN item ON i_item_sk=ws_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk=ws_sold_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns ON (ws_order_number=wr_order_number AND ws_item_sk=wr_item_sk)
  WHERE i_category='Women'
    AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.68 AND 0.88
    AND wr_reason_sk IN (9, 19, 23, 33, 44)
),
all_sales AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt, SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt

    UNION ALL

)
SELECT prev_yr.d_year AS prev_year,

       curr_yr.i_brand_id,
       curr_yr.i_class_id,

          ,cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt
          ,cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_return_amount,0.0) AS sales_amt
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk=cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk=cs_sold_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number=cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk=cr_item_sk)
    WHERE i_category='Sports'
      AND cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.77 AND 0.97
      AND cr_reason_sk IN (59, 63, 65, 68, 70)
    UNION
    SELECT d_year
          ,i_brand_id
          ,i_class_id
          ,i_category_id
          ,i_manufact_id
          ,ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt
          ,ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr_return_amt,0.0) AS sales_amt
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk=ss_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk=ss_sold_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN store_returns ON (ss_ticket_number=sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk=sr_item_sk)
    WHERE i_category='Sports'
      AND ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.77 AND 0.97
      AND sr_reason_sk IN (59, 63, 65, 68, 70)
    UNION
    SELECT d_year
          ,i_brand_id
          ,i_class_id
          ,i_category_id
          ,i_manufact_id
          ,ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt

    FROM web_sales
    JOIN item ON i_item_sk=ws_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk=ws_sold_date_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_returns ON (ws_order_number=wr_order_number AND ws_item_sk=wr_item_sk)
    WHERE i_category='Sports'
      AND ws_sales_price / ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.77 AND 0.97
      AND wr_reason_sk IN (59, 63, 65, 68, 70)
  ) sales_detail
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
)
SELECT prev_yr.d_year AS prev_year
      ,curr_yr.d_year AS year
      ,curr_yr.i_brand_id
      ,curr_yr.i_class_id
      ,curr_yr.i_category_id
      ,curr_yr.i_manufact_id
      ,prev_yr.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt
      ,curr_yr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt
      ,curr_yr.sales_cnt-prev_yr.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff
      ,curr_yr.sales_amt-prev_yr.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff
FROM all_sales curr_yr, all_sales prev_yr
WHERE curr_yr.i_brand_id=prev_yr.i_brand_id
  AND curr_yr.i_class_id=prev_yr.i_class_id
  AND curr_yr.i_category_id=prev_yr.i_category_id
  AND curr_yr.i_manufact_id=prev_yr.i_manufact_id
  AND curr_yr.d_year=1999

  AND prev_yr.sales_cnt > 0
  AND CAST(curr_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2))/CAST(prev_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2))<0.9
ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff,sales_amt_diff
LIMIT 100;

WITH filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price > 50
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
),
filtered_promotion AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND p_channel_event = 'N'
),
filtered_date AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-11-14' AS DATE) AND CAST('1998-11-14' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
ssr AS (
  SELECT
    s_store_id AS store_id,
    SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM store_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns
    ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
  JOIN filtered_date ON ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
  JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
  JOIN filtered_item ON ss_item_sk = filtered_item.i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_promotion ON ss_promo_sk = filtered_promotion.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 72
  GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT
    cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
    SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM catalog_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns
    ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
  JOIN filtered_date ON cs_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
  JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
  JOIN filtered_item ON cs_item_sk = filtered_item.i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_promotion ON cs_promo_sk = filtered_promotion.p_promo_sk
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 72
  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT
    web_site_id,
    SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM web_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns
    ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number
  JOIN filtered_date ON ws_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
  JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
  JOIN filtered_item ON ws_item_sk = filtered_item.i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_promotion ON ws_promo_sk = filtered_promotion.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 72
  GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT
  channel,
  id,
  SUM(sales) AS sales,
  SUM(returns) AS returns,
  SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || store_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

,cr_item_qty/(sr_item_qty+cr_item_qty+wr_item_qty)/3.0 * 100 cr_dev        ,wr_item_qty        ,wr_item_qty/(sr_item_qty+cr_item_qty+wr_item_qty)/3.0 * 100 wr_dev WITH date_filter AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_month_seq IN (
    SELECT d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date IN ('1998-03-05','1998-06-15','1998-09-12','1998-10-31')
  )
),
item_filter AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 45
),
sr_agg AS (
  SELECT sr_item_sk, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty
  FROM store_returns
  JOIN date_filter ON store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
  WHERE sr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
    AND sr_return_amt BETWEEN 141 * sr_return_quantity AND 170 * sr_return_quantity
  GROUP BY sr_item_sk
),
cr_agg AS (
  SELECT cr_item_sk, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty
  FROM catalog_returns
  JOIN date_filter ON catalog_returns.cr_returned_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
  WHERE cr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
    AND cr_return_amount BETWEEN 141 * cr_return_quantity AND 170 * cr_return_quantity
  GROUP BY cr_item_sk
),
wr_agg AS (
  SELECT wr_item_sk, SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty
  FROM web_returns
  JOIN date_filter ON web_returns.wr_returned_date_sk = date_filter.d_date_sk
  WHERE wr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
    AND wr_return_amt BETWEEN 141 * wr_return_quantity AND 170 * wr_return_quantity
  GROUP BY wr_item_sk
)
SELECT sr_agg.sr_item_sk AS item_id,
       sr_item_qty,
       sr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev,
       cr_item_qty,
       cr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS cr_dev,
       wr_item_qty,
       wr_item_qty / (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS wr_dev,
       (sr_item_qty + cr_item_qty + wr_item_qty) / 3.0 AS average
FROM sr_agg
JOIN cr_agg ON sr_agg.sr_item_sk = cr_agg.cr_item_sk
JOIN wr_agg ON sr_agg.sr_item_sk = wr_agg.wr_item_sk
JOIN item_filter ON sr_agg.sr_item_sk = item_filter.i_item_sk
ORDER BY item_id, sr_item_qty
LIMIT 100;
